actions.action: Gently lift the plant and inspect the roots
Check under the leaves and along the stems for pests
Bottom-water the pot in a tray or sink for 10-20 minutes, then drain
Empty standing water from the outer ceramic bowl after watering
Move the plant to the brightest spot available
Snip off dead or brown stems at the base
Check the soil every few days and water when the top half-inch is dry

reason: The answer correctly names underwatering as the main cause but blames low light instead of the poor soil/pot setup. Its bottom-watering advice partly matches the fix, though it soaks for minutes rather than overnight and explicitly defers the repot into fresh soil that worked. Bottom-watering would still help, so the advice isn't likely to make the plant worse.
